headlines.title: Prediction: Micron Stock Will Triple in 2027
headlines.summary: The memory company has been a big winner in 2026, and its run could continue in 2027.

headlines.title: Why Micron Stock Is Falling Today
headlines.summary: Micron is falling after Democrats swept the midterms and won the governor's races in Texas and Ohio, raising doubts about how fast new data centers get built.

headlines.title: Micron Sinks 6% as Democratic Sweep Stokes Fears of an AI “Slowdown in Build”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron shares fell 6% today as Democrats won control of Congress. Investors priced in a slower AI build-out, which Jim Cramer said would let memory inventories build up, a win for Apple.

headlines.title: Micron Stock Faces a Memory Price Conundrum in the Wake of Democrat Success
headlines.summary: Micron stock falls as investors digest the Democratic wave and signs rising memory prices are hitting some areas of the hardware market.

headlines.title: Apple’s Pain Could Be Micron’s Gain as Memory Prices Surge
headlines.summary: Memory prices are climbing fast, and that single cost is splitting two tech giants onto opposite sides of a trade. One company's suffering feeds the other's record margins, and the gap between them keeps widening.

description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of semiconductor memory and storage products in the United States, Taiwan, Mainland China, other Asia Pacific countries, Japan, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Cloud Memory Business Unit, Core Data Center Business Unit, Mobile and Client Business Unit, and Automotive and Embedded Business Unit segments. The company provides dynamic random access memory (DRAM) products, including High-Bandwidth Memory, doublie data rate, low-power DRAM, and graphics DRAM products; NAND products comprising solid state drives, managed NAND, and multi-chip packages; and NOR products. The company sells its products under the Micron brand name and private labels through its own direct sales force, sales or representative offices, as well as through distributors, retailers, and independent sales representatives. Micron Technology, Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, Idaho.
